mobbin:6ec8698e-d2a3-4d6f-a711-3e4025e51.summary: Admin opens the company home with admin quick actions and approval widgets, then lands on the employee portal home with personal onboarding and self-service chips.
steal: Step 0: Profile menu shows name + role (“Sam Lee, Admin”) and an explicit “Employee portal” link to switch views without logging out.
Step 0: Admin-only quick-action pills under the greeting (Add employee, Create post, New onboarding) plus an approvals widget (“1 unhandled” time-off request).
Step 1: Employee home swaps to a left icon sidebar and personal chips (Request time off, 5 tasks, Complete your profile 83%, Ask Co-pilot) plus a full-width “Go to your onboarding” banner.
Step 0: Empty widget states keep structure (“You have no assigned tasks”, “No upcoming birthdays this week”) instead of collapsing the layout.
avoid: Step 0→1: The role switch is a one-way “Employee portal” jump; the employee screen does not show the current role label or an obvious path back to Admin.
mobbin:6ec8698e-d2a3-4d6f-a711-3e4025e51.fit: Replaces the deferred role-specific widget layer: admin home keeps User management / Courses quick actions and approval queues on the dashboard; employee home hands off onboarding and profile tasks to Courses/User management and keeps personal recording/feedback entry light.
